name: Random Movie
overview: A random movie picker. Adds a dice button to the web UI that suggests a random movie from TMDB filtered by genre, year and minimum rating.
description: Adds a floating dice button on the Jellyfin web UI. Clicking it opens a dialog where you can pick a genre, a year and a minimum rating, and the plugin returns a random matching movie from TMDB (even if it is not in your library).
